author: imryaan
body:
Outbreak  TE DTM Made by Xuph & imryaan.

Album  (PLEASE READ THE SUBTITLES UNDER EVERY IMAGE) : http://imgur.com/a/2NMei

XML (soon)

DL  (not provided for TE maps.)

Map Features: 
- Green vs Yellow.
- 2 Monuments per team.
- Arrow spawner in middle (1 Arrow per 4 seconds) (64 Arrows per loadout) (UNBREAKABLE).
- Y 32 Height limit (Map is on Y 0).
- Sewer system that makes tunneling easier.
- Unique design for frontline islands.
- 8v8 TE

Credits to Legoche for the screenshot and Xuph for editing.

Check out our other map, Farmyard CTW TE!: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/a005d2432

replies.author: lgmatias
replies.body: I like the way the map looks aesthetically, although I'm inclined to believe it will play identically to rend. No one's gonna use that arrow spawner, it's too far away from any other point in the map, too low, and not rewarding enough to go to, especially with a 64 arrow kit. Either move it up to height or ditch it, although I'm not sure what you would change about this map to make it less rend.

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
The block combinations are unique but it still looks quite nice. As LG said, that arrow spawner will probs turn into no mans land ingame. Perhaps make it an iron spawner so there's an actual reason to go there? Not sure how that would play though, just an idea 

The one suggestion I could make would be to stretch each side out more. I say that because each side looks really compacted and squished together/slightly clusterfucked and then there's this massive void gap which is bigger than one of the sides.

Apart from that good detail and nice colour scheme, I don't think I've ever seen that combination, well done.

replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
replying to you and nathy;

i have few ways to try to change the spawner problem. tell me what you think.
- making loadout 16 arrows and spawner spawn 4 arrows every 10-8 seconds (thx raging)
- making the map mine gold, and the middle spawner spawn an iron ingot every 4 seconds or so
- making void gap smaller (dont recommend, will explain in next point)

replying to nathy;

i dont think void gap is a problem here. its dtm, and the sides have exactly the same void gap as rend, and the middle gap is smaller than rend's. by making a big gap we encourage mid sky because theres a control island in mid, so if we will fix the spawner problem its very likely that the gap wont be much of a problem. however we can;

- make the tree island extended and coming out more to the front to decrease the void gap
- make void gap smaller in general (not recommended because sides are in a perfect gap and balanced with the height limit when people will start skies).

imo id rather solve the void gap problem by the first solution, if you have any ideas please reply to this.

replaying to you;

i really dont think this map will play like rend. the shape looks a bit the same i agree, but we added many other game changing elements that rend doesnt have, and we believe they will change the way the game plays. for example;

- if we fix the spawner problem that you mentioned (i like changing map mines to gold and mid spawner will spawn iron) it could be really nice addition to the gameplay, and it will not be another boring side skies map.
- sewer system near monument (much easier to tunnel).
- 6 diamond blocks per team only. i believe those will be given to the defenders, so every defender has 1 set. if he dies, he doesnt have diamond anymore (in the xml we will remove diamond armor/block/entity drops, so once you die with it bye bye).
- also the map is way smaller than rend by length and size, just to mention
